title.en: Alice opens a channel to Bob

starter.cli:
# 1. Find Bob's node id (his public key).
BOB=$(JIFUNZE_NODE=bob lightning-cli getinfo | jq -r .id)
echo "Bob is $BOB"
# 2. Connect to Bob, then fund a 500,000-sat channel.
lncli connect "$BOB@bob:9735"
lncli openchannel --node_key "$BOB" --local_amt 500000

solution.cli:
BOB=$(JIFUNZE_NODE=bob lightning-cli getinfo | jq -r .id)
lncli connect "$BOB@bob:9735" || true
lncli openchannel --node_key "$BOB" --local_amt 500000
